employees.label: Employees (headcount)
employees.definition: Number of SAP employees by headcount in countries where SAP has 50 or more employees representing at least 10% of its total (ESRS S1 disclosure in the Integrated Report 2025's sustainability statement). Group total headcount was 111,397.

fte.label: Employees (full-time equivalents)
fte.definition: Full-time equivalents by region: EMEA (Europe, Middle East, and Africa), Americas (North America and Latin America) and APJ (Asia Pacific Japan); people on permanent contracts weighted by staffing percentage.

notes: SAP publishes no U.S. state data. Country headcount is disclosed only for countries with 50+ employees and at least 10% of the total (Germany, United States, India, unchanged from 2024) in the ESRS S1 section of the Integrated Report 2025 (headcount 111,397 at Dec 31, 2025); regions are FTEs from the 2025 20-F (EMEA/Americas/APJ, 110,650 FTEs in total; the filing defines them by continent, not by country list). Tax: the 2024 rows (current income tax expense split Germany vs foreign) were removed because the 2025 20-F and Integrated Report no longer print the 'Tax Expense by Geographic Location' table; SAP publishes no country-by-country tax report, and cash income taxes paid (€2,198m net in 2025) are reported only for the group. The 20-F also lists owned real estate in Newtown Square, Palo Alto and Colorado Springs (U.S.), Bangalore, Sao Leopoldo, London, Ra'anana and Sofia, which were not recorded as sites. The SAP report PDF returns 403 to curl's default user agent but downloads with a browser user agent.
